questions.q: What method must a Schedulable class implement?
questions.explain: The Schedulable interface requires one method: execute, which takes a SchedulableContext parameter.

questions.q: How many fields does a Salesforce CRON expression have, and which is optional?
options: Seven fields; the last one (year) is optional
questions.explain: A Salesforce CRON expression has seven fields — seconds, minutes, hours, day of month, month, day of week, and an optional year — with the year field being the only optional one.

questions.q: Why must exactly one of the day-of-month and day-of-week fields be set to ? in a CRON expression?
options: Because the two fields can conflict with each other, so the syntax requires explicitly leaving one unspecified rather than guessing which should take priority
Because Salesforce CRON expressions don't actually support a day-of-week field at all
Because ? marks the seconds field, not day-of-month or day-of-week
It's only a style convention with no functional requirement
questions.explain: Day-of-month and day-of-week can specify conflicting conditions (e.g. 'the 15th' vs. 'every Tuesday'), so Salesforce's CRON syntax requires exactly one of the two fields to be ?, leaving it unspecified rather than ambiguous.

questions.q: What is the maximum number of scheduled Apex jobs an org can have active at one time?
options: There is no cap on concurrently scheduled jobs
questions.explain: An org can have a maximum of 100 scheduled Apex jobs active at any one time — a standing concurrency cap on distinct scheduled jobs, not a daily execution count.

questions.q: Why does a scheduled job's execute method typically call Database.executeBatch rather than processing a large number of records directly?
options: Scheduled Apex's execute method runs under the same governor limits as a synchronous transaction, so large-volume work should be handed to Batch Apex instead
System.schedule doesn't support calling any other Apex code from inside execute
Database.executeBatch is required syntax inside every Schedulable class
Scheduled Apex jobs are not allowed to update any records at all
questions.explain: Scheduled Apex's execute method runs under ordinary synchronous-style governor limits, so a scheduled job that needs to touch a large volume of records should kick off a Batch Apex job from inside execute rather than processing everything itself.
